rest-pose rewards (balance, feet, upright) must cover ALL frames after the main event; r09-r11 walk-off / squat started exactly at the settle->stand label switch where they stopped. Detect: quant E per-segment drift.
a template fix exp(-err/std) with err >> std gives no gradient (r08: signal 1e-5). Detect: quant C signal < 0.05; fix: std of the order of the current error.
decided reward terms missing from the training run (r08 old process). Detect: quant F.
state knobs can be mutated after a round trained; diff the training logs (r09 curriculum).
the scalar score can rank the better policy lower (r10 end-tilt threshold); the decider sets the start checkpoint.
never-trained latency: 20 ms -> 70 % success, 40 ms -> 0 % (r14). Fix: randomised actuator delay.
arm speed / torso spin / action change after the event (r7)
pelvis-velocity term with scale 0.6 m/s (0.2 gave no gradient at 1.2 m/s, r10)
feet / tilt / waist limits after the event
global anchor position: height only after the event (r6 walked to the reference landing spot)
global orientation: tilt only after the event (r7 waist 115 deg)
reference padded with a rest-pose tail
_airborne: whole body > 5 cm and pelvis > 0.45 m (r2: lying + kicking counted as airborne)
rotation rewarded only when truly airborne
vertical speed only while both feet load
feet > max_d apart in the air (r4 star shape)
hip roll / yaw / knee separation limits (r7)
land / land_balance / feet_together also in stand_after (r12 fix of the r09-r11 walk-off)
landing = end of the FIRST airborne run (r9 hop after landing gave landing_offset 67)
hips one-sided, knees two-sided (r6 knees 2.9 rad)
